{{Quote|Flatlands of yellow sand and red earth.|Description}}
'''Deti Plains''' {{J|ディーテ平原|Dīte heigen}} is a location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It can be placed after completing "Mission #021: Hidden Vein" and is the site of "Mission #022: To Ambervale". In this mission, [[Cid Randell|Judgemaster Cid]] asks [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] to meet him at Deti Plains, however, a horde of monsters must be cleared out of the area first.

After the battle, Cid offers his help in working with [[Ezel Berbier]] in making the ultimate Antilaw. Deti Plains is also the site of "Mission #059: Sketchy Thief", "Mission #067: Missing Meow", and "Mission #094: Sorry, Friend". It can be freed in "Mission #257: Deti Plains" after "Mission #022: To Ambervale" is completed.
